Remember: Twice in one year, Iran was negotiating with the US & was bombed in the middle of talks. The narrative that now Trump has offered a "peace deal" & Iran is rejecting it is false. The US put forward its terms. Iran put forward its terms.


jeremy scahill (@jeremyscahill)

Iranian official tells me that Iran submitted its proposed terms and conditions for ending the war via intermediaries. The U.S. has not responded. Trump keeps falsely claiming Iran is begging the U.S. but it is

Among Iran's terms are: any deal apply to all fronts of resistance— Lebanon, Iraq and Palestine, that the U.S. recognize that Iran retains sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz, longterm guarantees of no further US-Israeli attacks, compensation for damage done during the war.

There are no direct negotiations happening between Iran and the US. The U.S. has repeatedly asked Iran for talks and Iran has thus far rejected or ignored them. The U.S. submitted its conditions for ending the war. Iran, in turn, submitted its own terms. All via intermediaries.
